CHOSEN — built and shipped.

The rail, the ⌘K palette, the phase pipeline cell and the filter chips are all in the app now.
The pieces below are what the shell added on top of the existing tokens.

Live behaviour that differs from this mock:
· Rail counts are absolute, never scoped by the current filters.
· Adding a filter on top of a view drops the highlight — you are no longer 'in' it.
· 'Save as view' is not built: views are code for now (src/lib/views.ts).

NOT CHOSEN — kept for reference.

B's detail panel is still worth stealing for the record page.
C would make a good extra view later; D's density ideas can fold into A.
